# Slogan Write-Up — "Where Global Goods Gather"

*Prepared for the owner and trademark counsel as part of the Trademarks packet. This write-up gathers, in one
place, the slogan itself, what it means, how it is used, why it functions as a trademark, and what is needed to
file it. **Not legal advice** — registrability and the filing are counsel's to determine. Current as of
2026-09-06.*

---

## 1. The slogan

**Where Global Goods Gather**

- **Type of mark:** slogan / tagline — filed as a **standard-character word mark** (protects the wording itself,
  in any font, size, style, or color).
- **Owner / applicant:** Ben Vick (confirm the final owning entity before filing).
- **Associated brand:** Get Goods Gratis (Free) — the slogan is the brand's tagline, typically shown beneath the
  wordmark/logo.
- **Presentation:** always in **title case** — "Where Global Goods Gather" — as four words, unpunctuated.

## 2. The slogan drawing (for a stylized/design filing, if desired)

If a stylized version is filed in addition to the standard-character word mark, this is the filing-ready
drawing — a USPTO-compliant black-and-white image (grayscale, within the 250–944 px range, 350 DPI, under 5 MB).
The standard-character word-mark filing needs no drawing; this image is for an optional special-form filing or as
a specimen reference.

## 3. What it means (brand rationale)

"Where Global Goods Gather" positions the platform as a **destination** — a single place that brings together
goods from around the world. Each element carries weight:

- **"Where"** frames the brand as a *place* (a marketplace/destination), not merely a service.
- **"Global"** signals breadth of selection and international sourcing.
- **"Goods"** ties directly to the retail/e-commerce identity — physical and digital products.
- **"Gather"** evokes bringing many things (and many people) together in one place, with a warm, communal tone.

The four-word alliteration on the hard "G" (**G**lobal **G**oods **G**ather) also echoes the **"G³" logo** (the
three G's of **G**et **G**oods **G**ratis), tying the slogan to the mark family.

## 4. How it is used

- **Placement:** shown as the brand tagline, typically **beneath the wordmark/logo** — in the site footer, on the
  sign-in/sign-up screen, and in the logo-plus-slogan lockup.
- **Consistency:** always the exact wording, in title case, as a **brand tagline** — a source identifier, not a
  sentence in body copy.
- **Symbol:** use **™** on prominent uses now to assert common-law rights; move to **®** only **after** a federal
  registration issues.

## 5. Why it functions as a trademark (not merely informational)

Slogans are registrable when they **identify and distinguish the source** of the goods/services rather than
merely conveying information or a common phrase. Points in this slogan's favor, for counsel to assess:

- It is **suggestive**, not baldly descriptive — it evokes a global marketplace without literally describing the
  goods or a feature; a consumer must make a small mental leap.
- It is used **consistently in a trademark manner** (as a tagline tied to the brand and logo), not as an ordinary
  informational phrase in running text.
- It is **not a common, everyday expression** that the public would perceive only as generally informational.

Counsel should confirm registrability, run a clearance search, and advise whether it belongs on the Principal
Register or may need a showing of acquired distinctiveness.

## 6. Compliance note (important)

The slogan is a **brand tagline about the marketplace** — it is **never** an earnings, income, returns, results,
or ROI claim, and must not be used or paired in a way that implies one. This keeps it consistent with the
platform's advertising-value (never revenue/ROI) compliance posture. Keep it descriptive of the marketplace
experience only.

## 7. Filing considerations

- **Primary filing:** **standard-character word mark** — "Where Global Goods Gather" — the broadest protection for
  the wording. No drawing or color is claimed.
- **Optional additional filing:** a **special-form/stylized** version using the black-and-white drawing above
  (no color claimed, for broadest coverage — consistent with the marks in this folder).
- **Suggested classes (confirm with counsel):** **35** (online retail / advertising & marketing services) and
  **42** (SaaS/software platform); add **9** if tied to the downloadable app.
- **Basis:** **Intent-to-Use (1(b))** if not yet in commerce, else **Use (1(a))**.
- **Specimen (to complete a use-based filing):** a real example of the slogan used as a tagline in commerce — the
  site footer, the sign-in screen, or the store listing where the tagline appears beneath the brand.
